links.targetTitle: Any SKY holder can force review of an Agent Artifact conflic

title: If an Agent will not fix its Artifact, Core GovOps can amend the Artifact for it
content:
A.1.14.2.10.2 defines a graduated enforcement pipeline. Core GovOps "may review an Agent Artifact... at any time," either reactively "in response to an issue that has arisen" or as part of a regular programme (A.1.14.2.10.2.1). Deficiencies are first shared privately with the Agent and its Operational Executor Agent (A.1.14.2.10.2.2), the Agent gets "a reasonable opportunity to respond" (A.1.14.2.10.2.3), and only then does Core GovOps consider that response and publish "a final set of findings to the Sky Forum under the category for the relevant Agent" (A.1.14.2.10.2.4).

The escalation lands in A.1.14.2.10.2.5: "The Agent must submit a Root Edit Proposal to update its Artifact to address the deficiencies identified in the final set of findings. If the Agent does not, Core GovOps may propose an Atlas Edit Proposal to directly modify the Agent Artifact to address the deficiencies."

So the Agent gets first refusal on its own remediation — its token holders vote on the fix — but refusal is not a veto. Non-compliance shifts the amendment to the Sky-wide governance process, where SKY holders rather than Agent token holders decide. Autonomy is preserved as a *preference*, not as a guarantee.

A.1.14.2.10.2.6 provides the check on the reviewer: "If the Agent disagrees with the final set of findings of Core GovOps, the Core Facilitator resolves the dispute" — an appeal to a different actor rather than to the one that made the finding.

The notable gap is A.1.14.2.10.3: "Penalties for an Agent failing to meet the requirements... will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas." The enforcement regime is therefore incomplete by its own admission. Today the only real consequence of neglecting an Artifact is having it amended over your head — a corrective, not a deterrent.
description: Review, shared findings, right of response and published conclusions culminate in a duty to remediate by Root Edit
